function.description: Preview a Pendle PT trade — quote buying a PT with a payment token, selling a PT early, or redeeming a matured PT (output, price impact, feeUsdEstimate — Pendle's own estimated route fee in USD — aggregator, liquidity). Quotes route through Pendle's AMM only — limit-order liquidity is excluded, so a better resting price may exist. Exact-output is impossible: you specify amountIn and receive an estimate, never a guaranteed amountOut. This call has a SIDE EFFECT — it records the prequote authorization the matching broadcast tool requires, so quoting arms that tool for ~15 minutes. Read-only.
function.name: pendle__pt__quote

amountIn.description: Amount of tokenIn in human-readable units.

chain.description: Chain slug or id — one of Pendle's 11 chains (e.g. 'ethereum', 'arbitrum', 'base', 'bsc').

tokenIn.description: Input token address (payment token for a buy; PT address for a sell/redeem).

tokenOut.description: Output token address (PT for a buy; payment/underlying for a sell/redeem).
